overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board discussed an unanticipated topic under a general "Report from Departments" heading, and the AG declined to review a late minutes-accuracy allegation. Chair was encouraged, not ordered, to seek more detailed topics from department heads.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed a topic not listed on its October 23 notice: the town administrator's attempt to schedule a site visit with the Conservation Commission.
allegations.key_passage: Because the topic was unanticipated, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by proceeding with a discussion of it.

allegations.summary: Request for further review alleged the Board's October 27 meeting minutes were inaccurate; this was raised only after the original complaint was filed.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this additional allegation because it is beyond the scope of the original complaint filed with the public body.
